properties.name: A2226/26 / LMML
properties.originalText:
SUSPENSION OF VFR/IFR CIRCUITS AND SUSPENSION OF AIRWORK 
APPROVALS.

LMML-LMML TRAINING FLIGHTS AND INTERNATIONAL VFR FLIGHTS MAY BE 
SUBJECT TO DEPARTURE DELAYS AND SIGNIFICANT HOLDING DELAYS ON 
ARRIVAL DUE TO HEAVY TRAFFIC AT LMML. THESE FLIGHTS SHOULD PLAN TO 
AVOID ARRIVAL AT THESE TIMES.

LOCAL VFR FLIGHTS OPERATING WITHIN THE CTR MAY BE SUBJECT TO 
DEPARTURE DELAYS.

STATE-SANCTIONED, MILITARY AND HEMS FLIGHTS EXCLUDED.
